test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Azhar (2016), a sports-related movie, is based on which of the following sports?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cricket**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anthony D'Souza **is the **director **of the **2016** Indian Hindi biographical sports drama film **Azhar**.
 
• The life of** Indian cricketer** and former captain of the national team **Mohammad Azharuddin** served as inspiration for the narrative.
 
• **Emraan Hashmi** plays the lead in the Sony Pictures Networks production, which is produced by Shobha and Ekta Kapoor.
 
• On May 13, 2016, the movie was released globally.
